structural_hypothesis: Across all 32 fresh banks, zero missing true edges, zero weak true edges under evidence weights, and at least 95% of retained extra edge-bank pairs weak under evidence weights. The finite-bank conjunction is supported iff all three exact count criteria pass, otherwise falsified. Zero extra edges satisfies the fraction criterion vacuously.
statistical_scope: Finite-bank descriptive structural hypothesis only. Pair-bank counts are dependent and are not treated as independent Bernoulli draws. No accuracy or universal edge-performance claim.
heldout_access: No held-out inputs, labels, trajectories or accuracy outcomes loaded during this source-only stage. No GPU work.
shared_fit: One M1000/N1110 fit per bank shared by all three weightings: 2000 calibration queries plus 27750 training queries.
weights: Uniform 1 on retained pairs. Evidence 1 if exact rational fixed-q1 LR<=1, otherwise1/16. Excluded weights0. No floating decision or outcome tuning.
shuffle: Dedicated full3240-pair permutation generated before calibration/training observations; restrict to retainedpairs and assign firstK weak weights, withK from evidence multiset only. Fixed permodel across all inputs/searches; no observed weak-pair identities used.
normalization: Strong penalty unit1, no mean/permodel normalization; temperature .4→.31, theta .45, tau0, ebar0, tol.001, fourchains,262144moves.
no_selection: All 32 banks and their calibration undercoverage/fallback events remain included. No thresholds, weights or search settings adjusted from source diagnostics. A later held-out stage, if allocated, uses all these banks unchanged and a new frozen cohort.
prospective_heldout_hypothesis: Evidence minus uniform canonical exact-match accuracy>=10pp; evidence minus shuffled accuracy>=10pp; evidence accuracy>=70%; zero invalid certified stops across all3arms.
prospective_accuracy: Exact match to stored canonical solution, including capped returns. Certified accuracy, correct capped returns, validity, compatibility and given-given conflicts reported separately.
prospective_inference: Unchanged H1ah backend, unit1, tau0, ebar0, temp .4 to .31, anneal 524288, theta .45, four chains, check4096, cap262144, tol .001; 5000 paired two-way bootstrap draws, seed20418000. A later protocol must freeze cohort, budget and wrappers before inference.
calibration: Unchanged 99.5% outward-grid exact Clopper-Pearson bound from 1000 repeated-query disagreements; independent Decimal80 endpoint and predecessor audit; safe fallback. q0=eta/4-9eta^2/64, q1=1/9, crossing boundary648000.
budget: Source-only CPU preparation, eight concurrent acquisition/replay pipelines. No GPU allocation or held-out reservation.
limitations: Only independent replacement noise family at actual eta=.05.
Finite-bank geometry diagnosis is postfit only and does not imply accuracy.
Positive weights preserve the zero set, not returned-best accuracy.
No joint calibration or true-edge-retention claim across 32 banks.
Future canonical accuracy includes capped returns and must separate certification.
